chemical.name: Urea (46% N)
chemical.application_notes: Apply in 2-3 split doses to reduce volatilization and leaching; avoid applying before forecast heavy rain.
chemical.compatibility_notes: Do not mix with rock phosphate or lime.

chemical.name: Ammonium Sulphate (21% N, 24% S)
chemical.application_notes: Useful where sulphur is also deficient; slightly acidifying in alkaline soils.
chemical.compatibility_notes: Safe with most phosphatic and potassic fertilizers.

organic.name: Farmyard Manure (FYM)
organic.application_notes: Apply 10-15 tonnes/ha 2-3 weeks before sowing; improves N availability gradually and enhances soil microbial activity.
organic.compatibility_notes: Can be combined with biofertilizers like Azotobacter/Rhizobium.

organic.name: Vermicompost
organic.application_notes: Apply 2.5-5 tonnes/ha into topsoil; excellent for slow-release nitrogen plus active enzymes and humic substances.

chemical.name: Single Super Phosphate (SSP, 16% P2O5, 11% S)
chemical.application_notes: Best applied basal (at sowing) placed near root zone since phosphorus is immobile in soil; provides valuable calcium and sulphur.
chemical.compatibility_notes: Do not surface broadcast without soil incorporation.

chemical.name: DAP (18-46-0)
chemical.application_notes: High P + some N; place 3-5 cm below and to the side of seed furrow to avoid seedling injury.
chemical.compatibility_notes: Avoid direct contact with germinating seeds.

organic.name: Rock Phosphate
organic.application_notes: Slow-release mineral P source; works best in acidic soils or co-composted with FYM / PSB (phosphate solubilizing bacteria).
organic.compatibility_notes: Not effective in high-pH calcareous soils without microbial inoculation.

organic.name: Bone Meal
organic.application_notes: Slow-release organic P and Ca source; mix thoroughly into the root zone prior to planting.

chemical.name: Muriate of Potash (MOP, 60% K2O)
chemical.application_notes: Apply basal or in early growth stage; avoid on chloride-sensitive crops like tobacco, potato, and grapes.
chemical.compatibility_notes: High salt index; incorporate evenly into moist soil.

chemical.name: Sulphate of Potash (SOP, 50% K2O, 17% S)
chemical.application_notes: Chloride-free premium K source; highly recommended for vegetables, fruits, and saline-prone soils.

organic.name: Wood Ash
organic.application_notes: Modest K source (3-7% K2O); has liming effect - avoid on already alkaline (pH > 7.5) soils.
organic.compatibility_notes: Do not mix directly with nitrogenous fertilizers to avoid ammonia gas loss.

organic.name: Composted Banana / Crop Residue
organic.application_notes: Traditional regional K-rich organic input where available; mulch or incorporate into topsoil.

organic.name: Green Manure (Dhaincha / Sunhemp)
organic.application_notes: Grow and plough in at tender flowering stage (45-50 days after sowing) to add 15-20 tonnes/ha fresh biomass and build organic carbon.
organic.compatibility_notes: Reduces subsequent chemical N requirement by 25-30%.

organic.name: Compost / FYM / Biomass Mulch
organic.application_notes: Regular seasonal incorporation builds permanent organic carbon; best combined with minimum tillage and crop residue retention.
organic.compatibility_notes: Enhances water-holding capacity and cation exchange capacity.

chemical.name: Zinc Sulphate Heptahydrate (ZnSO4·7H2O, 21% Zn)
chemical.application_notes: Apply 25 kg/ha worked into soil once every 2-3 seasons for basal correction.
chemical.compatibility_notes: Do not mix directly with phosphatic fertilizers (SSP/DAP) in tank or band (forms insoluble zinc phosphate).

chemical.name: Foliar Zinc Sulphate (0.5% ZnSO4 + 0.25% Lime)
chemical.application_notes: For standing crop deficiency: spray 0.5% ZnSO4 neutralised with 0.25% slaked lime during calm weather (temp <30°C, wind <15 km/h).
chemical.compatibility_notes: Spray early morning or late afternoon; avoid mid-day sun.

organic.name: Zinc-Enriched Farmyard Manure
organic.application_notes: Incubate 10-15 kg ZnSO4 with 500 kg well-decomposed FYM for 30 days before field application; improves micronutrient uptake efficiency in high-pH soils.
organic.compatibility_notes: Prevents fixation of zinc in alkaline/calcareous soils.

chemical.name: Ferrous Sulphate Foliar Spray (FeSO4·7H2O, 19% Fe, 0.5-1.0%)
chemical.application_notes: Soil application of iron is often fixed in alkaline/calcareous soils; foliar spray of 0.5-1% FeSO4 with 0.1% citric acid is significantly more effective.
chemical.compatibility_notes: Apply twice at 10-14 day intervals in morning or evening.

organic.name: Compost / FYM with Humic Substances
organic.application_notes: Improves overall iron and micronutrient availability over time by lowering rhizosphere pH locally and releasing natural organic chelators.
organic.compatibility_notes: Essential for calcareous soils with pH > 7.8.

chemical.name: Agricultural Gypsum (Calcium Sulphate, 16-18% S, 22% Ca)
chemical.application_notes: Excellent sulphur source that also reclaims sodic and alkaline soils; broadcast and incorporate into moist soil.
chemical.compatibility_notes: Improves soil structure and water infiltration.

chemical.name: Elemental Sulphur (80-90% S)
chemical.application_notes: High concentration sulphur; slower-acting as it requires soil microbial oxidation (Thiobacillus) to convert to plant-available sulphate.
chemical.compatibility_notes: Has strong acidifying effect; excellent for high-pH soils.

organic.name: FYM / Bio-compost
organic.application_notes: Contains modest organic sulphur alongside N, P, K; builds organic matter and microbial cycling over successive seasons.
